assessment_mode: read-only diagnosis; no training, optimizer construction, backward pass, prediction generation, checkpoint rewrite, or finalize command

source_locations.finding: Constructs the selected configuration model and optimizer, trains it, restores best_state, builds checkpoint metadata, and writes output_root/checkpoints/candidate_<candidate_index>.pt with torch.save at line 479.
Runs the four search configurations, then calculates selected_checkpoint_identity.json SHA-256 at line 537 after the search checkpoint has been written.
Sets selected_config, loops over FINAL_SEEDS, changes only seed, calls train_configuration again, then saves the returned bundle to final_seed_<seed>.pt.
Defines candidate index 3 as hidden_dim 64, learning_rate 0.003, seed 61003 and final seeds 62001-62005.

execution_stage_order.result: Each CANDIDATES entry invokes train_configuration; candidate_3.pt is initially written by train_configuration:479 during the candidate_index=3, seed=61003 call.

candidate_search_results.json, candidate_epoch_histories.jsonl, selected_configuration.json, and selected_checkpoint_identity.json are written; expected identity e94c94... is calculated from candidate_3.pt at line 537.
For every final seed, config is dict(selected_config, seed=seed), preserving candidate_index=3.
Each final-seed invocation writes its checkpoint dictionary to the same candidate_3.pt path before execute saves the same returned dictionary to its final_seed_<seed>.pt path.
The seed=62005 invocation is last; candidate_3.pt therefore contains seed 62005, epoch 43, and candidate_index 3 metadata. final_seed_62005.pt is then written from the same checkpoint dictionary.

root_cause: The final-seed loop reused train_configuration with the selected search configuration and passed the existing output_root. train_configuration unconditionally derives its checkpoint path from configuration.candidate_index and writes candidate_3.pt. The final loop did not redirect or suppress that write before saving the distinct final-seed path.

path_vulnerability.generic_code_scope: The implementation would overwrite the candidate path for whichever candidate_index was selected; it does not overwrite all candidate paths during the final loop.
path_vulnerability.this_execution: Only candidate_3.pt was vulnerable because selected_configuration.json selected candidate_index 3.

other_scientific_artifacts.note: The failed execution later wrote its available reporting artifacts, but the checkpoint overwrite mechanism itself targets only the selected candidate path.

conclusion: candidate_3.pt was first the selected search checkpoint, its expected SHA was recorded after candidate search, and it was subsequently overwritten five times by final-seed invocations; the surviving file is the final seed 62005 serialization.
